pose_formula_check.scope: Rigid lower-frame pad offset rotates with Rx(a) Ry(b+c). The brief subtracts an unrotated Z offset; both measured errors are retained.

sweep.pose_table_note: colliding_pose_indices in each pair index this table; collision_samples keeps only the first eight.
sweep.scope: Nominal rigid envelopes; discrete pose samples, not a continuous collision proof. No cables, fasteners, stops, encoders, covers, batteries or measured shell interior.
sweep.distance_method: Exact BRep distances; sorted AABB lower bounds prune queries that cannot reduce the exact minimum. All potentially intersecting configurations receive exact common-volume queries. Rigid-frame and unchanged-angle invariance reuse exact results.

mass.method: Centroid-lumped sum m*r^2, not tensor inertia. Fixed J1 case/mount included in carrier (hip hardware fixed to the cradle). Foot separate from lower subtotal. Three hardware allowances lumped at P1, posed P2 and P3; moving knee allowance at P3. Neighbors excluded.
mass.clock_mass: Catalog complete clock 229 g; retained mass unknown. Body envelope carries zero counted mass.

brief_conflicts: Foot centre target subtracts a world-Z offset, inconsistent with rigid lower-frame posing. Both errors reported.
Unchanged example knee.mount_side is inline; proximal requires inboard/outboard and refuses inline.
status: PACKAGING STUDY WITH BENCHMARK ACTUATOR BLOCKS — NOT A FITTED, SELECTED OR LOAD-QUALIFIED DESIGN
provenance: Body numbers are the WB-8 catalog envelope (axis mapping unverified). Hip origins, offsets and link lengths are the J04-L01-S01 sketch values, kept so the model lists what that sketch collides with. Actuator block is the XL330-M288-T size/mass benchmark; it is not selected. Every bracket, plate, shaft, bearing, pulley and belt is a proposed envelope with an assumed density, not a purchased part.
